rows.text: The Reserve Bank today left the Official Cash Rate unchanged at 3.5 percent.
The Reserve Bank today left the Official Cash Rate unchanged at 3.5 percent.
Trading partner growth continues at around its long-term average, but remains dependent on highly accommodative monetary settings.

The New Zealand economy continues to grow at an annual rate of around 3 percent, supported by low interest rates, high net immigration and construction activity, and the fall in fuel prices.
